question: What outcome follows from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Death related to age is named.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to death from age.
uncertainties: The intended sense of vayo mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyate is ambiguous and may mean overcoming or undergoing age-death.
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will go to death by old age.
